shellCommands.command: find .agents -type f | head -100 && echo --- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo --- && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md | head -100

grep -n -i -A12 "page-constructor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,80p; echo ----; for p in uikit icons i18n; do echo $p; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json').version"; done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -40; echo; git status --short

timeout 300 npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor@^8.24.1 @diplodoc/transform@^4.28.2 2>&1 | grep -v "Unknown env config" | tail -20; node -p "['@gravity-ui/page-constructor','@diplodoc/transform','@gravity-ui/uikit'].map(p=>p+'@'+require('./node_modules/'+p+'/package.json').version).join('\n')"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs 2>/dev/null

cat blocks/Header.md; echo; echo =====; cat blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md; echo; echo =====; cat blocks/Banner.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && node -p "require('./package.json').main + ' | ' + JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').exports ? Object.keys(require('./package.json').exports) : null)"; ls build | head; grep -rhoE "export (declare )?(type|interface|const|function) (PageConstructor[A-Za-z]*|ContentProps|Content[A-Za-z]*)" build --include=*.d.ts | sort -u | head -30; echo ---; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/sass >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "sass present" || echo "sass MISSING"; grep -n '"sass"\|sass-embedded' package.json /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json

awk 'NR<=230 && /"(dependencies|devDependencies|peerDependencies)"/{s=$0} NR==227{print s; print "line227: " $0}' package.json; grep -rn "content" build/esm/**/PageConstructor*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; f=$(grep -rl "interface PageConstructorProps" build --include=*.d.ts | head -1); echo "$f"; grep -n -A12 "interface PageConstructorProps" "$f"; grep -rn "export type ContentProps\|export type PageConstructorContent\|export type ContentLayoutBlockModel" build --include=*.d.ts | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && timeout 300 npm install -D sass@^1.63.6 2>&1 | grep -v "Unknown env config\|allow-scripts" | tail -4; node -p "require('./node_modules/sass/package.json').version"; grep -n -A30 '"dependencies"' package.json | head -40; cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && grep -rn "PageContent\b" build/cjs/index.d.ts build/cjs/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -rln "export type PageContent " build --include=*.d.ts | head -2
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "Unknown env config" | tail -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles && ls; grep -rn "~@gravity-ui\|@import" *.scss | head -30; echo ---; cat ../package.json | grep -n "\"vite\|vite-plugin" ; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -rn "~@gravity-ui/uikit" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm 2>/dev/null | head -3
timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "Unknown env config\|DEPRECATION\|More info\|╷\|╵\|│\|^\s*$\|root stylesheet\|@import\|omitted" | tail -40

timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "Unknown env config\|DEPRECATION\|More info\|╷\|╵\|│\|^\s*$\|root stylesheet\|@import\|omitted\|node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles" | tail -40; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
